resolution: Corrected the acceptance criteria: the textured raster was authored for the pre-stack UV coordinates, so widespread apparent mapping errors are expected and cannot validate stacking. Pre-regeneration acceptance is structural and automated; human visual review becomes meaningful only after a fresh atlas is generated for the new coordinates. The remaining user decision is the per-zone density policy, not locating individual texture mismatches.
